senses.gloss: strip; shreds of garments ravelled into threads for wicks.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:1">Shek. V, 1</cite> <he>בן בבי</he> (<cite ref="M01653"><he>ממונה</he></cite>) <he>על הפ׳</he> Ben Bebai was appointed to superintend the preparation of wicks from the shreds of priestly garments; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:5">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> (interch. with <he>הפתילה</he>).

senses.gloss: a strip of leather, a strap used as a whip.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 23a:10">Yoma 23ᵃ</cite> <he>לוקה … בפ׳</he> he is smitt en by the overseer with a strap (expl. <cite ref="M00327"><he>מַדְרָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01070"><he>מְטַרְקָא</he></cite>).
Ib. (ref. to Shek. l. c.) אמינא מאי פ׳ נגדא I would now say, p’ḳiʿa means strap (appointed to execute punishment).—
Eduy. III, 5 בית הפ׳ (Rabad הפְּקִיעָה) that end of the bow from which the thong is snapped

senses.gloss: [that which is to be stripped or ravelled,] bundle, bunch.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:15">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>הרשט לי פ׳ זה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>פ׳ עמיר</he>) hand me this bunch (of sheaves).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:4">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 4</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01492"><he>פְּקִיעִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01492"><he>פְּקִיעִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 24:2">Sabb. XXIV, 2</cite> <he>מתירין פְּקִיעֵי עמיר וכ׳</he> you may untie bundles of sheaves for the cattle &c.
Ib. 155ᵃ הן הן פ׳ הן הן כיפין p’ḳiin and kippin mean the same things.
Ib. פ׳ תרי bunches are called p’ḳiin, when tied with two bands, v. כִּיפָּה.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:4">Tosef. Succ. I, 4</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: that which has been chipped off, piece.—Pl. as ab., v. פֶּקַע
